name: Mapuche

colors.symbolism: the sky and the spirit world
strength and the blood of history

description: Three horizontal bands of blue, green and red, the blue and red edged with black-and-white stepped guemil borders, charged at the centre with a yellow kultrun drum bearing a cross-shaped star.
history: The Wenufoye ('canelo of the sky') was created in 1992 by the Council of All Lands (Aukiñ Wallmapu Ngulam) as the flag of the Mapuche people of Chile and Argentina, and has become the universal emblem of Mapuche identity and protest. The kultrun is the machi's ceremonial drum, its face a map of the cosmos; the stepped border is the guemil pattern of Mapuche textiles.

features.role: with black-and-white stepped guemil borders between bands

features.symbolism: the machi's drum — the Mapuche cosmos
